import time, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan
from validate import validate_plan

def test(name, n, links, caps, parts):
    t=time.time()
    plan = build_plan(n, links, caps, parts, {v:r for v,r in parts})
    dt = time.time()-t
    if plan is None:
        print(name, 'FAIL %.2f' % dt); return
    errs = validate_plan(plan, n, links, caps, parts, {v:r for v,r in parts}, None)
    print(name, 'ok' if not errs else errs[:2], 'trees',len(plan['trees']),'routes',len(plan['routes']),'rec',len(plan['recipes']), '%.2fs'%dt)

m=16
links=[(i,(i+1)%m) for i in range(m)]
parts=[(i,1) for i in range(m)]
test('ring-tight', m, links, [8]*m, parts)
# 2. path of 16 participants
links=[(i,i+1) for i in range(m-1)]
test('path', m, links, [16]*len(links), parts)
